title: Technical Product Manager Deep‑Dive Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan to master the technical and product skills needed for platform and API product leadership. Focuses on depth, best practices, and building a showcase portfolio.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build core technical literacy and empathy for engineering teams.

milestones.title: API and System Basics
milestones.outcome: Can explain how APIs, microservices, and data flows work in a platform.

tasks.title: Read API fundamentals on MDN
tasks.description: Study the MDN guide on RESTful APIs and common patterns.

tasks.title: Sketch a simple system diagram
tasks.description: Draw a diagram of a three‑service architecture using pen and paper.

tasks.title: Watch freeCodeCamp API video
tasks.description: Complete the 20‑minute video on building a basic API with Node.js.

tasks.title: Write a 200‑word API overview
tasks.description: Summarize the purpose and key components of the API you sketched.

milestones.title: SQL Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can query a relational database to extract product usage metrics.

tasks.title: Complete SQL basics on Khan Academy
tasks.description: Finish the introductory module covering SELECT, WHERE, and JOIN.

tasks.title: Run sample queries in SQLite
tasks.description: Install SQLite locally and execute five example queries from the tutorial.

tasks.title: Create a usage report query
tasks.description: Write a query that returns daily active users for a mock product.

tasks.title: Explain query results to a peer
tasks.description: Describe what the query shows and why it matters for product decisions.

milestones.title: Developer Empathy
milestones.outcome: Can anticipate engineering concerns and communicate effectively with dev teams.

tasks.title: Read "The Pragmatic Engineer" blog post
tasks.description: Read the article on developer motivations and pain points.

tasks.title: Interview a developer (mock)
tasks.description: Prepare three questions and conduct a 15‑minute interview with a colleague about their workflow.

tasks.title: Document empathy notes
tasks.description: Write a one‑page summary of insights and how they affect product decisions.

tasks.title: Share notes in a Slack channel
tasks.description: Post your summary to a team channel and invite feedback.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Apply technical knowledge to product specifications and prioritisation frameworks.

milestones.title: Technical Specification Writing
milestones.outcome: Can produce clear, actionable specs for API features.

tasks.title: Read Google API design guide
tasks.description: Study the section on spec structure and versioning.

tasks.title: Draft a spec outline
tasks.description: Create an outline for a new endpoint using the guide’s template.

tasks.title: Add sample request/response JSON
tasks.description: Write example payloads for success and error cases.

tasks.title: Get feedback from a peer
tasks.description: Share the draft with a developer and incorporate their comments.

tasks.title: Finalize the spec document
tasks.description: Produce a polished spec ready for review.

milestones.title: Prioritisation Frameworks
milestones.outcome: Can rank features using data, impact, and effort criteria.

tasks.title: Study RICE scoring on ProductPlan blog
tasks.description: Read the article explaining Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort.

tasks.title: Create a RICE spreadsheet
tasks.description: Set up a Google Sheet template for scoring backlog items.

tasks.title: Score three mock features
tasks.description: Apply RICE to three example features and record results.

tasks.title: Discuss scores with a teammate
tasks.description: Explain your rankings and gather alternative viewpoints.

tasks.title: Write a short prioritisation rationale
tasks.description: Summarize why the top‑ranked feature should be built first.

milestones.title: Delivery Planning Essentials
milestones.outcome: Can design realistic release plans and track delivery milestones.

tasks.title: Read Atlassian guide on release planning
tasks.description: Study the best practices for sprint and release roadmaps.

tasks.title: Map a release timeline
tasks.description: Create a visual timeline for a 3‑month product launch using a whiteboard.

tasks.title: Identify key milestones
tasks.description: List at least five delivery milestones and their owners.

tasks.title: Set up a tracking board
tasks.description: Configure a Trello board with columns for each milestone stage.

tasks.title: Review plan with a mock stakeholder
tasks.description: Present the timeline and get feedback on feasibility.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio pieces that demonstrate end‑to‑end product ownership.

milestones.title: API Product Spec Portfolio
milestones.outcome: A polished API spec ready to showcase to recruiters.

tasks.title: Select a real API gap
tasks.description: Identify a missing endpoint in a public API you use frequently.

tasks.title: Research competitor implementations
tasks.description: Find how similar APIs solve the problem and note differences.

tasks.title: Write full spec document
tasks.description: Produce a complete spec with description, parameters, responses, and error handling.

tasks.title: Create a mock Swagger UI
tasks.description: Use Swagger Editor to render the spec and generate example calls.

tasks.title: Add the spec to a portfolio site
tasks.description: Upload the document and UI screenshots to a personal website or GitHub repo.

milestones.title: Technical Roadmap Project
milestones.outcome: A strategic roadmap outlining platform evolution over 12 months.

tasks.title: Define roadmap scope
tasks.description: Choose a platform area (e.g., authentication) and set objectives.

tasks.title: Gather data from public sources
tasks.description: Collect usage stats and trend reports relevant to the scope.

tasks.title: Draft quarterly milestones
tasks.description: Create a timeline with key features, dependencies, and timelines.

tasks.title: Add risk and mitigation notes
tasks.description: Identify three major risks and propose mitigation strategies.

tasks.title: Present roadmap to a peer group
tasks.description: Run a 15‑minute walkthrough and collect critique.

milestones.title: Data‑Backed Feature Proposal
milestones.outcome: A proposal that uses SQL analysis to justify a new feature.

tasks.title: Select a product problem
tasks.description: Pick a common user pain point that could be solved with a new feature.

tasks.title: Extract usage data with SQL
tasks.description: Write queries to quantify the problem’s impact on key metrics.

tasks.title: Create a visual data story
tasks.description: Build a simple chart in Google Sheets showing the pain point trend.

tasks.title: Write a feature proposal document
tasks.description: Combine data, user story, and solution outline into a concise proposal.

tasks.title: Share proposal for feedback
tasks.description: Post the document in a professional forum and note suggestions.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Refine advanced practices and prepare for job or client engagements.

milestones.title: Advanced API Strategy
milestones.outcome: Can design scalable API products with versioning and governance.

tasks.title: Read Microsoft API design principles
tasks.description: Study the guidance on versioning, throttling, and security.

tasks.title: Create a versioning plan
tasks.description: Draft a policy for major/minor version changes for your API spec.

tasks.title: Simulate a deprecation workflow
tasks.description: Write a step‑by‑step plan to retire an old endpoint safely.

tasks.title: Discuss strategy with a mentor
tasks.description: Schedule a 30‑minute call to review your plan and get advice.

tasks.title: Document lessons learned
tasks.description: Summarize key takeaways in a one‑page cheat sheet.
